people_phone_digits.name: people_phone_digits
people_phone_digits.value: "people"."phone" IS NULL OR (length("people"."phone") = 8 AND "people"."phone" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')

transactions_reversal_reason.name: transactions_reversal_reason
transactions_reversal_reason.value: "transactions"."reverses_id" IS NULL OR "transactions"."reason" IS NOT NULL

transactions_transfer_reference.name: transactions_transfer_reference
transactions_transfer_reference.value: "transactions"."payment_method" IS NOT 'transfer' OR "transactions"."bank_reference" IS NOT NULL
